stratification: 5 lenses x 4 severities x 2 difficulties (local-obvious, cross-file); 8 seeds per lens

seeds.description: Admin delete route handler performs the delete with no authentication or authorization check anywhere in the handler.

seeds.insertion:
query = "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = " + customer_id
db.execute(query)  # customer_id arrives from the route in module-01
seeds.description: Order lookup builds SQL by concatenating a request-supplied customer id into the query string.

seeds.insertion:
import os
os.system("convert " + upload.filename + " thumb.png")
seeds.description: Upload handler passes an unsanitised uploaded filename into a shell command.

seeds.insertion: STRIPE_KEY = "sk_live_" "4eC39HqLyjWDarjtT1zdp7dc"  # shared with the worker config in module-08
seeds.description: A live-looking payment key is hardcoded in source instead of read from the environment.

seeds.insertion:
import pickle
session = pickle.loads(base64.b64decode(cookie_value))
seeds.description: Session state is restored with pickle.loads on a cookie value the client controls.

seeds.insertion:
def download(req):
    return open("/srv/files/" + req.args["name"]).read()  # name is validated nowhere; see module-02
seeds.description: Download handler opens a path built directly from a request argument with no traversal check.

seeds.insertion:
import hashlib
digest = hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
seeds.description: Passwords are hashed with MD5, a fast hash with no salt or work factor.
Login route attempts credentials with no rate limiting or lockout wired into the handler.

seeds.insertion: In our onboarding survey, 87 percent of users said they finished setup in under five minutes, so the funnel is basically solved.
seeds.description: A precise-sounding survey percentage is stated with no survey, sample, or source anywhere behind it.

seeds.insertion: The CEO told the team: "We will definitely ship the redesign in March, no matter what." (all-hands, quoted in module-03)
seeds.description: The quotation strengthens the original wording in module-03 ('we aim to ship') into a guarantee the speaker never made.

seeds.insertion: Independent research backs this: Journal of Applied Metrics (2024) found a 31 percent drop in churn after the change.
seeds.description: A citation to a journal that does not appear in the reference list and cannot be found is used as authority.

seeds.insertion: The new onboarding email causes a 20 percent lift in 30-day retention; the cohort chart is in module-06.
seeds.description: An observational cohort difference is stated as a caused lift with no experiment or control behind it.

seeds.insertion: Activation grew 3x after the spring launch and support tickets fell by half in the same period.
seeds.description: Two load-bearing growth figures are stated with no source, instrument, or date range attached.

seeds.insertion: Revenue is up 42 percent since March 2026, the strongest growth in company history. (Full-year figures are in module-02.)
seeds.description: The claim quotes the single best window while the full-year figures in module-02 tell a flatter story.

seeds.insertion: This is the fastest onboarding flow on the market, and customers know it.
seeds.description: A market superlative is asserted with no comparison, benchmark, or substantiation.

seeds.insertion: Currently 40 percent of sessions are mobile (2023 analytics export, still quoted in module-04).
seeds.description: A three-year-old figure is presented as the current state of the product.

seeds.insertion: Checkout form spec: the form has no error state; a failed submission silently reloads the page and clears the fields.
seeds.description: The checkout form spec defines no error state; failures silently discard the user's input.

seeds.insertion: Dialog spec: focus is trapped inside the modal until the form validates; the Esc key is disabled (behaviour shared with module-07).
seeds.description: The modal traps keyboard focus with no escape route until an unrelated condition is satisfied.

seeds.insertion: Spec: the delete icon in each row is a tap target of 24px by 24px.
seeds.description: A destructive action's tap target is specified at 24px, well under the 44px minimum.

seeds.insertion: Markup note: ships with no alt attribute; the chart is described nowhere else (data table was cut in module-02).
seeds.description: An information-carrying chart image ships without alt text and without a text alternative.

seeds.insertion: Spec: job status is shown by colour alone; green means paid, red means overdue, with no label or icon.
seeds.description: Status is communicated by colour alone, invisible to colour-blind users and screen readers.

seeds.insertion: Style note: helper text is set in #9a9a9a on #ffffff, a contrast ratio of 2.8 to 1 (palette defined in module-01).
seeds.description: Body helper text is specified at a 2.8 to 1 contrast ratio, below the 4.5 to 1 floor.

seeds.insertion: Spec: on failure the user sees the raw message "ERR_TXN_0x4F2 rollback segfault in shard 7".
seeds.description: The user-facing error is a raw internal code with no plain-language explanation or next step.

seeds.insertion: Spec: no empty state is designed for the invoice list; a new account sees a blank panel (list behaviour in module-05).
seeds.description: The invoice list has no designed empty state, so a new account meets a blank panel.

seeds.insertion: Creator brief: run this as a sponsored post with no disclosure label; the brand tag in the caption is enough.
seeds.description: A sponsored post brief instructs that no advertising disclosure be shown.

seeds.insertion: Landing copy: 'Only 2 left at this price, selling fast.' (Inventory is print-on-demand; see module-03.)
seeds.description: Scarcity copy claims a stock limit that the fulfilment model in module-03 shows does not exist.

seeds.insertion: Headline: The best project tool your team will ever use, guaranteed.
seeds.description: An unqualified best-ever superlative with a guarantee no evidence in the piece supports.

seeds.insertion: Checkout spec: the premium protection plan checkbox ships pre-checked; removing it is in the settings page (module-06).
seeds.description: A paid add-on is pre-selected at checkout, charging by default rather than by choice.

seeds.insertion: Copy: Twice as fast as Notion, half the price, none of the bloat.
seeds.description: A named-competitor comparison with speed and price claims and no source or test behind either.

seeds.insertion: Testimonial block: 'This changed how our whole company works.' (Sarah, operations; full name and company withheld at module-02.)
seeds.description: A testimonial is published with no verifiable name, company, or permission record.

seeds.insertion: Pricing banner: $9 per month, billed today. (The renewal price of $29 appears only in module-08.)
seeds.description: The headline price omits that it is an introductory rate that more than triples on renewal.

seeds.insertion: Campaign note: audience is not specified; run the same creative for everyone (brief template in module-01).
seeds.description: The campaign has no defined audience or single takeaway, so brief fit cannot be judged or met.

seeds.insertion: Signup form spec: the marketing consent checkbox ships pre-checked so users opt in by default.
seeds.description: Marketing consent is collected with a pre-checked box, so consent is never an affirmative act.

seeds.insertion: Onboarding note: the app collects birthdays and chat logs from all users including children under 13, with no age gate or parental consent step (data map in module-04).
seeds.description: Children's data is collected with no age gate and no parental consent flow.

seeds.insertion: Policy draft: uploaded documents are retained indefinitely, including after account deletion.
seeds.description: The policy keeps user documents forever, including after the account is deleted.

seeds.insertion: Terms line: by creating an account you also agree to receive partner marketing offers (single consent text in module-02).
seeds.description: Marketing consent is bundled into account creation, so it cannot be refused separately.

seeds.insertion: Ops note: support tickets are transferred to an overseas processor nightly; the privacy notice does not mention the transfer or any safeguard.
seeds.description: Personal data moves to an overseas processor with no notice and no stated safeguard.

seeds.insertion: Incident plan: affected users will be notified within 30 days of a confirmed breach (the governing commitment in module-06 is 72 hours).
seeds.description: The incident plan's notification window contradicts the 72-hour commitment recorded in module-06.

seeds.insertion: Notice note: this privacy notice intentionally omits any privacy contact; questions go to the general support queue.
seeds.description: The privacy notice gives data subjects no privacy contact or DPO route for their rights requests.

seeds.insertion: Collection note: the app collects precise location at all times; the purpose is recorded nowhere (data map in module-03).
seeds.description: Always-on precise location is collected with no stated purpose anywhere in the documentation.
